Upstream: GNOME Shotwell
Tag: shotwell-0.30.14

Original files (unchanged):
  src/ColorTransformation.vala
  src/util/KeyValueMap.vala
  src/_transformation.c
  COPYING

These three source files implement the real Shotwell colour transformation
engine. They are compiled as a separate local batch executable, not reimplemented
as an approximate gamma curve or linked into the navigation algorithm.
Adapter source: ../../standalone/shotwell_reference/EnhancePalette.vala
Pinned hashes and build command: ../../standalone/EnhanceEdgeSonarShotwell.py
The adapter's Gdk.Point declaration is only for unused red-eye metadata methods.
